title: Group of Six Men Outside Building, 1948 B&W Vintage Photograph
description: A clear post-WWII black and white photograph showing six men standing side-by-side outside a brick building featuring decorative glass blocks. Taken on July 5, 1948, the men are dressed in late-1940s attire with high-waisted trousers, collared shirts, and one man wearing a tie. The background shows a suburban or small-town American street scene.
